name: Croc Transfer
author: alexdont
description: Send a file to anyone, anywhere, without a terminal: drop it on the bar, paste the code to your recipient, done. End-to-end encrypted via croc — no accounts, no shared network. Receive side included

barWidget.description: Drop files on it to send them with croc; click to open the transfer card. Shows live progress.

schema.label: Custom croc relay
schema.description: host:port of your own croc relay. Empty uses croc's default public relay (which only ever sees encrypted traffic).
